Page.description: Page root. Holds every section of one screen in vertical order.

Navbar.description: Top navigation bar with brand name, menu links and one call-to-action label.

Hero.description: Hero section: eyebrow, large headline, supporting subtitle and a slot for action buttons.

FeatureGrid.description: Grid of product features or benefits, each with an icon, title and short description.

Stats.description: Row of key numbers or metrics with labels, e.g. customers served or uptime.

Pricing.description: Pricing table comparing plans with price, period, feature list and one highlighted plan.

Testimonials.description: Customer testimonials: quotes with the customer's name and role.

FAQ.description: Frequently asked questions as an expandable list of question and answer pairs.

CTA.description: Call-to-action banner with a headline, subtitle and a slot for action buttons.

ContactForm.description: Contact or sign-up form section. Put Input, Textarea and Checkbox primitives in `fields` and the submit Button in `actions`.

Footer.description: Page footer with brand, link columns and copyright line.

Banner.description: Thin announcement bar at the very top of a page with a short message and a link label.

LogoCloud.description: Row of customer or partner brand names that build trust ("trusted by").

ImageText.description: Split section: image on one side, eyebrow, title, description and bullet points on the other, with an actions slot.

Steps.description: How it works: numbered steps a customer follows, each with title and description.

ProductGrid.description: E-commerce product cards with name, price, optional badge and short description.

Gallery.description: Image gallery grid with captions, e.g. portfolio, rooms, menu photos.

Team.description: Team members or experts with name, role and short bio.

Timeline.description: Chronological timeline: company history, event agenda or roadmap with date, title and description.

ComparisonTable.description: Feature comparison table between plans or products. `columns` are only the plan or product names (no header for the feature column); each row has a feature name and exactly one value per column, e.g. ✓, ✗ or a short value.

BlogList.description: List of articles or news posts with category, title, excerpt and date.

Quote.description: One large highlighted quote from a founder, customer or press, with author and role.

Newsletter.description: Newsletter or waitlist sign-up strip. Put an email Input in `fields` and a Button in `actions`.

ContactInfo.description: Contact details such as address, phone, email and opening hours, each with an icon.

AuthForm.description: Centered login or sign-up card for an app. Put Input and Checkbox primitives in `fields` and Buttons in `actions`.

KPIGrid.description: Dashboard KPI cards for an app screen: metric label, value, change and trend direction.

DataTable.description: Data table for an app screen (orders, users, transactions) with column headers and rows of cells.

EmptyState.description: Empty or success state message for an app screen with an icon, title, description and an actions slot.

Button.description: Button for actions. Lives in an `actions` slot.

Input.description: Single-line text field with label. Lives in a `fields` slot.

Textarea.description: Multi-line text field with label. Lives in a `fields` slot.

Checkbox.description: Checkbox with a label, e.g. accept terms. Lives in a `fields` slot.

designSystems.name: Shadcn
designSystems.summary: Monochrome, utility-first, black primary on white
rules: Monochrome UI: hierarchy comes from weight and size, not color.
Primary buttons are solid near-black; every other action is outline or ghost.
Thin 1px borders and subtle elevation; no gradients.

designSystems.name: Vercel
designSystems.summary: Stark black and white with a precise blue link color
rules: Large tight headlines over generous white space; content speaks for itself.
Accent blue only for one primary action or link per screen.
Use grids with hairline dividers instead of cards with shadows.

designSystems.name: Clean
designSystems.summary: Ample whitespace, limited palette, legible type
rules: Reduce visual clutter: at most one decorative element per section.
Neutral grey surfaces separate sections; the accent stays near-black.
Favour short copy and clear labels over long descriptions.

designSystems.name: Editorial
designSystems.summary: Magazine serif typography on warm paper
rules: Serif display headlines with a clear reading rhythm; body copy reads like an article.
Rust accent sparingly: one kicker or one CTA per screen.
Structured grids, pull quotes and generous section spacing.

designSystems.name: Warm Editorial
designSystems.summary: Soft cream surfaces, serif headlines, rounded corners
rules: Warm, human tone in copy; avoid corporate jargon.
Serif headlines with sans body; rounded generous cards.
One warm accent; neutrals carry most of the page.

designSystems.name: Dashboard
designSystems.summary: Data-dense product UI with a sky-blue signal color
rules: Information density is the feature: compact spacing, tabular numbers, no decoration.
Sky accent marks only the current state or the primary action.
Use semantic colors (success, danger) for data, never for decoration.

designSystems.name: Corporate
rules: Structured, predictable layouts; proof (logos, numbers, case studies) near the top.
Blue accent for the primary action only; secondary actions are outline.
Formal but plain-language copy; no hype adjectives.

designSystems.name: Friendly
designSystems.summary: Playful orange on sunny cream, very rounded
rules: Conversational, upbeat microcopy with specific verbs.
Rounded shapes and soft surfaces; orange only for the main action.
Illustration-like placeholders are fine; keep text short and warm.

designSystems.name: Luxury
designSystems.summary: Near-black canvas, gold accent, high-contrast serif
rules: Dark, quiet canvas; let large serif headlines and space create the premium feel.
Gold accent at most twice per screen; never as large fills.
Few words per section; evocative, specific copy.

designSystems.name: Neobrutalism
designSystems.summary: Heavy type, hard borders, vivid orange on warm yellow
rules: Bold, chunky display type and thick borders; flat colors, no gradients.
High contrast and raw layouts; one vivid accent.
Short punchy copy.

designSystems.name: Publication
rules: Editorial grid with strong typographic contrast between headline and body.
Square corners everywhere; rules and dividers instead of cards.
Red accent for one kicker or link per screen.

designSystems.name: Linear (dark)
designSystems.summary: Dark-mode precision, luminance hierarchy, indigo signal
rules: Dark canvas; hierarchy through text luminance (bright headline, dim body).
Hairline borders and subtle surfaces instead of shadows.
Indigo accent only for the primary action and one highlight.

navigate.description: Prototype navigation: show another frame of the project.
